usedFor: Linear holds issues and projects, and Tookan receives field work through “Create a Pickup and Delivery Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Issue Created” in Linear, then “Create a Pickup and Delivery Task” in Tookan
bestTemplate.why: A new issue can become a pickup and delivery job without retyping its details.

watchOut: “Create a Pickup and Delivery Task” in Tookan needs delivery details, so the Linear issue must carry them.
